profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Backend, Data & Ethical ML Systems | Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL | Former VP Eng
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and scaling production systems across ads, payments, data pipelines, and growth infrastructure.

I’m currently working as an independent engineer building ethical, human-in-the-loop ML systems, with a strong focus on backend architecture, data integrity, and operational reliability. My work centers on Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and background job processing, with careful attention to correctness, audibility, and long-term maintainability.

Previously, I was a Senior Software Engineer at Etsy, where I worked on ads and payments systems that drove meaningful revenue impact, experimentation platforms, and seller-facing tools. I later served as VP of Engineering & Technology at a growth-stage retail startup, founding the engineering organization, scaling infrastructure, and leading teams through rapid expansion.

I bring hands-on fullstack engineering depth alongside seasoned technical judgment from building and operating complex systems in high-impact environments. I’m especially strong in ambiguous problem spaces that require clear architecture, pragmatic decision-making, and thoughtful collaboration across engineering, product, and leadership.

Outside of day-to-day engineering, my background spans scientific research and professional ballet—experiences that shape how I approach systems with rigor, care, and clarity.

See more about me at nevettebailey.com

positions.title: Independent Research Engineer - Ethical ML Systems
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Building a production-grade backend system in Python and FastAPI to support ethical, human-in-the-loop ML workflows.
• Designed and implemented REST APIs, data models (PostgreSQL/JSONB), and background jobs (Celery, Redis) for data ingestion and verification pipelines.
• Integrated multiple external data sources (TMDB, Wikipedia, web search, LLM APIs) with source attribution and confidence scoring.
• Focused on backend architecture, data integrity, and audit-ability for sensitive, high-impact domains.

positions.title: Vice President of Engineering & Technology (Founding Engineer)
positions.description:
• Founded and led the engineering organization for a growth-stage retail company.
• Designed and scaled e-commerce and internal systems supporting multi-store expansion with high reliability.
• Built CI/CD pipelines, data infrastructure, and operational processes that improved delivery speed and system quality.
• Partnered closely with product and leadership to align technical architecture with business goals.

honors.title: Ford Foundation Dissertation Fellowship 2016
honors.description: The Ford Foundation Dissertation Fellowship is intended to support the final year of writing and defense of the dissertation. Dissertation fellowships will be awarded in a national competition administered by the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine on behalf of the Ford Foundation. The awards will be made to individuals who, in the judgment of the review panels, have demonstrated superior academic achievement, are committed to a career in teaching and research at the college or university level, show promise of future achievement as scholars and teachers, and are well prepared to use diversity as a resource for enriching the education of all students.
